title: Setup wizard
preferencesDesc: Turn the water-table PR rating on if you want it — you can change everything later in Settings.
appearanceDesc: Pick a theme mode and a window background; clicking previews it live, and you can change it later in Settings.
prToggleDesc: Show the PR rating on player stat cards.
prAlgoDesc: Which formula computes the PR score.
teamWrToggleDesc: Weight the live-battle team winrate by ship tier; off takes the plain average.
sealsToggleDesc: Inked 神了/海猴/蛆 verdict seals — Chinese UI only.
localizedTiersToggleDesc: Fun localized tier wording; off shows the standard English bands.
gameDesc: WoWSP scanned this machine for World of Warships installs — click one to confirm it as the active client, or re-scan / browse for the folder manually.
pluginDesc: Consider installing the WoWSP in-game plugin: live battles gain the precise TAB ordering and more reliable detection signals, it renders nothing in-game, and it uninstalls anytime.
pluginDone: In-game plugin installed — live battles pick it up automatically.
